notes: The key lemma avoids the documented pitfall, but the conclusion relies on (N), an additional hypothesis absent from the problem. Take X={0,1} with the indiscrete topology and V_n=Δ_X for every n. All stated relation assumptions hold, yet A_n(0)={0} and A_n(1)={1} form a nondiscrete family. The draft acknowledges this counterexample but proves only a strengthened statement.
